cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose the Precedent
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The handbook says lock the hall at six. Our festival permit says stay open till eight. Which governs tonight?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the front open and lock the back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. So the permit governs public access, and the handbook governs everything else?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Including the kitchen closing at six.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are we canceling the seven-o'clock supper, or does the permit govern kitchens too?
